hook: Why do so many people with good jobs still feel broke every month? In this video I look at it from three angles: the numbers (the $400 test, $1 trillion in card debt, the hidden costs of being broke), the psychology (10 mental traps that keep smart people stuck) and the playbook (10 steps to escape, in order).

Three people, three ways out of being broke
Why most people stay broke, in 30 seconds
